item.description: Ashleigh Stewart is a Senior Research Coordinator at Melanoma Institute Australia, based at Macquarie University. Learn about her fascinating work in the liquid biopsy space, plus why working in the melanoma field is particularly important to her.

item.title: Bequests | Helen Godwin
item.description: Inspired by the work of Melanoma Institute Australia, Helen Godwin decided to support MIA through a bequest in her will. Her family recently visited MIA’s Translational Research Laboratory at Charles Perkins Centre (University of Sydney) and heard first-hand how Helen’s generosity will help support melanoma research projects, and ensure her legacy will make a lasting difference.
